name: deck-craft
description: Self-contained slide-deck skill spanning three output targets from one body of deck craft: self-contained fixed-stage HTML presentations, lecturn.deck/1 JSON (and .pptx through the deckconv round-trip), and Diolog investor decks assembled from the 140-template / 12-recipe slide library. Carries its own visual-design layer rather than depending on a general design skill: consuming a supplied DESIGN.md or token file as binding context, authoring a direction when no brand exists (scheme / formality / density, subject-mined palettes, the signature element, the swap test), typography sized for projection with tracking and measure rules, colour strategy and accent budgets, five-vector hierarchy and cross-slide rhythm, anti-slop rules, and an accessibility floor calibrated for projection. Deck-specific narrative discipline: the title sequence as the deck's argument, speaking-vs-reading density, one idea per slide, deliver-the-whole-count, and the linear-flow usability rules (per-slide trunk test, recognition over recall, the honesty gate on charts and claims). Ships a per-slide build gate and a delivery review built on the verification epistemics that rendering an image is not seeing one, that the question you bring to a capture determines what you see in it, and that a clean gate means no known defect rather than verified. Direction evidence is read progressively from the template libraries on the machine (frontend-slides bold pack, open-design deck templates, portable design systems) without bulk-reading them. v1.1 folds the slide-template library into the skill: 200 layouts across 27 families, 21 recipes, the full slot contract and every validator rule. v1.2 closes the pipeline-integration gaps with the mandatory render_deck loop. v1.3.0 folds in portable ideas from impeccable. v1.7.0 turns the prose gate into an executable preflight probe. v1.8.0 hardens initial first-pass generation to eliminate design-review failure modes: establishes pure deterministic SVG charts by default, standardises Base64 asset inlining, and enforces dual-theme dark-band contrast tokens. v1.9.0 introduces dedicated Investor Relations & Retail Investor domain craft (references/investor-relations.md): ISO 9241-303 / AVIXA DISCAS closed-form typography legibility derivations, two-tier type floor preflight calibration, IBCS financial chart standards (shared-scale ROI comparison bars, zero-baseline mandate, waterfall bridge bounds), asymmetric editorial photo splits, brand geometric signatures (custom polygon chevrons, 8px grounding beams), uncompressed 12-slide quarterly and capital allocation recipes, floating minimalist glass chrome, and regulatory disclosure invariants (ASX GN14, ASIC RG 230, SEC Reg FD/G).
